newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks rise on strong selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks rise on strong selective buying.

text.p: Argentine stocks finished higher Tuesday on strong selective buying and traders predicted the gains could continue in coming days.
The leading Merval stock index of Argentine blue chips climbed 0.59 percent to 610.56 index points.

"The market moved with the seesaw movements of the U.S. in the early part of the session, but gradually strong selective buying of stocks like Ciadea, which rose seven percent, took the market higher," said Jose Napoli, from Ignoto y Napoli brokerage.
The rise in volume to 20.7 million pesos, from 17.0 million pesos on Monday, was one indicator of a firming market, traders said.
"The market has a solid base and the arrival of new foreign capital will create an upward tendency in the coming days, although analysts say some profit-taking will be healthy," a trader said.
Some 26 stocks rose in the session, 19 declined and 17 remained unchanged.
Among the main advancers were car maker Ciadea, up 7.4 percent, and Banco Galicia, which rose 3.36 percent.
